LESSON: PLAY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.8: Play

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Play. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Play
2. Practise Play at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Play

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Play
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Play. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Play at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Play at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Play
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Play. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Play using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Play in the examples.
2. Explain Play to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Play.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Play using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Play important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Play
2. Practise Play at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Play

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
